messages:
alex.p: FYI — CI auth migration to the Identity Gateway is scheduled Thu 2026-05-14 00:00-01:30 UTC. This replaces repo PATs and Okta app tokens with short-lived machine tokens from idp-proxy. Read: https://docs.internal/idp-proxy/ci-migration (please skim before EOD)

mira.s: Are there any immediate breaking changes we should expect? Who needs to take action?

alex.p: Short list:
- Workflows with hardcoded PATs in repo secrets will fail and must be rotated/removed
- Self-hosted runners must run runner-agent >=0.9.2 to perform token exchange
- We introduce an org-level role `ci-runner` for mapped service accounts
Please test in `redwood-ci-staging` with CI_IDP_TEST=1 and report failures.

nina.devex: I'll send a migration checklist to repo-owners and create a PR template. Can we get a sample repo for validation?

ryan.infra: Test repo: `infra/ci-migration-samples` — contains example workflows, secrets cleanup script, and a Helm chart to deploy the proxy agent locally.

sam.sre: Rollout plan: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automated health checks. If auth error rate increases we'll flip to Okta passthrough (30m fallback) while we patch.

canary-bot: Canary sequence scheduled to start -00:45 UTC. Required gates: workflow_success_rate >= 99%, token_exchange_p50 < 250ms.

infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance: idp-proxy CI cutover. Expected window: 1.5 hours. Subscribe to #incidents for live updates.

mira.s: Security note: please rotate any PATs found in plaintext. We'll run a secrets scan post-cutover and force-rotate flagged tokens.

alex.p: Confirmed — security will audit and rotate discovered tokens after the migration window.

nina.devex: Action items recap:
- Dev teams: test by Wed EOD and file checklist PR
- Runner owners: upgrade agent to 0.9.2+
- Repo admins: review service-account mappings and accept invites
I'll coordinate a pre-cutover smoke test on Fri 12:00 UTC.

sam.sre: Dashboards to watch: `ci.auth.errors`, `runners.registration.latency`, `github.actions.failure_rate`. Alerts: Pager for P1, Slack for P2.

alex.p: Thanks all. Post blockers in this thread and ping @ryan.infra for infra emergencies. :rocket:
